༄༅/ /zla gsang las/bsad pa mthar thug gdug pa me'i las sbyor bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// zla gsang las/ bsad pa mthar thug gdug pa me'i las sbyor bzhugs so//

ya mān+ta ka la na mo/ gshin rje tshe bdag nag po'i phrin las bzhi'i ya gyal drag po'i sbyin sreg ni/ gsang sngags kyi sreg chog spyi 'gro ltar byas pas 'grub la/ 'di ni srung bzlog bsad pa'i mtha' rgyas liṅga sreg pa'am/ yang na glo bur dgra bgegs gang rung gis 'tshe na de nyid bsad pa'i las gtso bo 'don pa'i man ngag drag po'i sreg chog shin tu zab cing gnyan pa ni 'di lta lte/ phung sa las byas pa'i stegs bu rgyar mda' gang*/ dpangs su ji tsam ran pa'i steng du ma traṃ gi lto bar rtse mo lhor bstan pa'i thab khung gru gsum pa/ kha khyer steng ma la brkyangs khru gang la/ bar ma dang 'og ma de las sor mo gnyis re nang du bskums pa'i bang rim gsum pa'i dbyibs lcags kyi brub khung lta bu rtsig brus gang bde byas pa'i lte bar khro bo'i rdo rje rgya gram nag po'i lte bar raṃ yaṃ brtsigs pa dang*/ kha khyer rnams su rdo rje phyed pa dang mtshon cha sna tshogs rtse mo phyir bstan pas bskor ba thams cad du dug sna khrag sna rgya sol dang sbyar bas nag por byugs| sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar gzas pa'i rus pa ming rus can bsad sngags kyis bskor ba dug khrag gri rdzas kyis sbags pa bcer ba'i snying gar me tshang bca'/ thab nang du ro bsregs pa'i shing dang*/ dug shing dang*/ tsher ma can gyi shing skam dug sna khrag sna sbags pas bkang*/ sgrub mjug yin na bsad pa'i 'khor lo dang ling chung*/ glo bur yin na bsad 'khor dang ling chung bris la rdzas kyis byugs pa dang*/ sreg rdzas sngar gyi shing de nyid lta bu la byas pa'i yam shing sor bcu pa rtse mo gnyis rno zhing dbyibs dug khrag dang khyi brun til mar byugs pa la ro skra dang yug skra bsres pa dgos/ mchan/ gru gsum pa zung du sbyar ba brgya rtsa brgyad/ liṅga ming rus bris pa dri rdzas dang dug khrag gis sbags pa brgyad/ 'bru nag dug khrag gis sbrus par dri rdzas bsres pa'i ril bu brgya rtsa brgyad/

gzhan yang tshil chen dang dug khrag gis sbags pa'i til mar/ zangs phye/ lcags phye/ dur rdo/ 'bru nag /mi'i sha rus/ yungs kar/ ske tshe/ shangs tshe/ nim+ba/ ro thal/ bong sbangs/ khyim bya'i tshil/ phub ma/ zi ra dkar nag rnams bsres pa'i thod ngan nang du bcer ba dang*/ rdzas de las byas pa'i rū pa zag pa sogs dri ma bsres pa'i snying khar ming rus bris pa'i gzugs mtho gang pa gcig dang sha chen gyi dum bu brgya rtsa brgyad rang gi g.yas dang*/ khrag chen gyi ar+ghaṃ dang zhabs bsil/ dug dang dbang po lnga'i me tog /sha chen dang gu gul gyi spos/ tshil chen gyi mar me/ mkhris chen dang chang gi dri chab/ sha khrag gis sbags pa'i zhal zas/ rkang gling gi rol mo rnams dang*/ g.yon du rdor dril dang mi rus sogs kyi dgang blugs/ sman raka/ gtor ma/ rlung g.yab nag po/ phur thun/ mi bsad pa'i mtshon cha sogs mdun du bshams/ sra ba'i gdan la bsgrub bya'i gzugs kyi snying khar g.yon brkyang stabs kyis 'dug cing*/ zhwa gos nag po dang*/ mgo la me long btags/ rak+sha'i phreng ba se ral khar bya/ de nas glo bur ba yin na skyabs sems dang bdag gi rnal 'byor bsgom/ bzlas pa bya/ de nas sreg rdzas dang mchod rdzas rnams las gshin sngags kyis bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las snod rnams ma las nyi ma dang*/ a las zla ba ste nyi zla ga'u kha sbyor du gyur pa'i nang du/ bdag gi thugs ka nas hūm̐ nag po gcig spros/ hūm̐ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa/ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐/ 'od du zhu ba 'od phung las byung ba'i rin po che'i mchod sdong 'od zer nag po 'phros pas dgra bgegs thams cad thogs med du gsod pa'i nus pa dang ldan pa/ yam shing ma gtogs pa'i rdzas rnams ngo bo ro brgya dang ldan pa'i bdud rtsi la/ rnam pa dgra bgegs dmigs bya sha khrag gi phung po stong gsum khengs par gyur/ ces dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gsum brjod/ sgrub pa dang ma 'brel na/

skabs 'dir mkhyen dgongs dpang gzu brub khung bskyed pa bla 'gugs lha bla 'gyu dus bla 'gugs srog 'gyu dus phur thunasogs brdeg /bla srog 'gyu dus sreg pa'i las bya dgos so// mchan/ dbye/ nyes byas drag bskul/ phur gdab/ byang chub lam ston sogs 'don cha rnams rdzogs par bya/ bshan pa'i me ro sol la sbar bas thab khung gi me tshang sbar zhing*/ e raṃ traka raṃ phaṭa raṃ dz+wa la raṃ/ zhes dang*/ e raṃ yaṃ/ zhes rlung g.yab g.yab/ til mar blugs gzar bdun gyis me gso zhing*/ oṃ ag+na ye swā hā/ zhes brjod/ de nas thab bsangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ dang rdo rje nag po las byung ba'i gshin rje'i gshed nag po/ g.yas 'khor lo dang g.yon lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ khro rngam 'bar ba'i dur khrod kyi chas brgyad dang ldan pa/ g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang gis bsgyings pa/ de yongs su gyur pa las byung ba'i e las drag po'i thab khung gru gsum pa/ kha khyer bang rim gsum pa/ zab cing rgya che ba'i nang du dug gi me rlung 'bar zhing 'khrugs pa'i dbus su/ raṃ las skyes pa'i me lha dmar skya khro gtum can zhal gdangs shing khro gnyer g.yo ba/ phyag gnyis rdor dril 'dzin pa'i hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya thugs kar brtsegs pa/ dur khrod kyi chas brgyad dang ldan pa ra skyes kham pa 'ja' 'od lnga dang glog gis brgyan pa/ zhing gi ya mgal gyi snga ru ma mgal gyi phyi ru/ sga la zhing lpags kyis bkab cing*/ sbrul nag gi gong rmed byas pa'i steng du zhon pa'i dbu la me thod bcings pa/ de'i g.yas g.yon mdun rgyab bzhir/ pra mo ha bzhi zhal gcig /phyag bzhi| spyan gsum pa/ g.yas dang pos chu srin gyi rgyal mtshan/ 'og mas ye shes kyi me 'gal/ g.yon dang pos me dar/ 'og mas dril bu bsnams pa gcer bur bsgreng bar gyur/ oṃ ag+na ye ka bya dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ oṃ pra mo ha dza dzaḥ oṃ/ lho phyogs nas rang 'dra'i ye shes pa spyan drangs gnyis su med par gyur pa'i gtso bo'i thugs kar ya ma ti ra baṃ zhes pa'i gshin gtso bo bskyed dus rang nyid ces pa dang*/

yum bskyed dus rang tshe bdag tu ces pa rnams dor zhing*/ de'i thugs kar gser gyi 'khor lo sogs dor nas/ de'i thugs kar 'jam dpal sku mdog dmar nag ces zlog pa'i dus ltar la/ rab tu khros shing cher 'bar ba de'i thugs kar nyi ma'i gdan la rdo rje nag po rtse lnga pa'i lte bar hūm̐ mthing nag gis mtshan par gyur/ ces pa rnam gdon pa bsgyur dgos so// rje pho mo'i gdan zhes pa nas/ mthu rtsal dang ldan par gyur gyi bar ngag 'don ltar bya/ lha rnams kyi zhal rab tu gdangs pa'i ljags khro bo'i rdo rje nag po'i rnam pa can la raṃ yig dang*/ dgang blugs kyi kha la hūm̐ res mtshan par gyur| par dmigs nas/ oṃ ya mān+ta ka kā la rū pa ya ma rā dza ag+na ye dgra bgegs che ge mo dz+wa la raṃ/ zhes dgang blugs brgya rtsa brgyad dang*/ oṃ ya mān+ta ka kā la rū pa ya ma rā dza ag+na ye bo dhi bṛk+ṣa ya dgra bgegs che ge mo dz+wa la raṃ/ zhes yam shing zung du sbyar ba brgya rtsa brgyad dang*/ 'khor lo ling chung dang sbrags pa bsgrubs pa sngon du ma song na mkhyen dgongs nas btun brdung yan rdzogs par byas pa'i rkang pa g.yon pa nas gri lcags kyis gtub dgra la byed na las sbyor 'di dus yin nges shig nges par gal che ba yod do// kyin dbul zhing*/ oṃ e ka ya ma du ru tsakra/ he ka ya ma du ru tsakra/ gh+ri ma ya ma du ru tsakra/ sarba tsit+ta gzir thuṃ bhig nan trig nan rbad ya zlog ya sod ya ag+na ye dgra bgegs che ge mo mā ra ya dz+wa la raṃ/ zhes brgya rtsa brgyad dang*/ rdzas la byas pa'i dgra gzugs gri lcags kyis gtubs pa'i tshal pa re re dang*/ sha chen gyi dum pa re re dang sbrags te dbul zhing*/ oṃ sa ma ya ār+ya mañju e la tsakra e rā ga badz+ra ming trig nan srog hur thuṃ dzaḥ ming srog la mā ra ya ag+na ye dz+wa la raṃ raṃ/ dgra bgegs che ge mo mā ra ya phaṭa/ ces brgya rtsa brgyad/ ling rkyang brgya rtsa brgyad po re re ril bu re re sbrags nas dbul zhing*/

e ka he dun ya ma snying khrag ra ma tsa ya sa na ga ru raṃ sa na ga u raṃ gzer phyung srog ru raṃ tsit+ta bring shag thuṃ rbad/ e ra gnod byed 'byung po dz+wa la raṃ mā ra ya phaṭa/ ag+na ye dgra bgegs che ge mo mā ra ya mā ra ya dz+wa la raṃ/ zhes brgya rtsa brgyad kyis sreg rdzas bsres pa rnams/ ya ma me dak+ṣe rā tsa sa do ru ṇa yo ni ra ya tsa ni ag+na ye dgra bgegs che ge mo mā ra ya dz+wa la raṃ/ zhes brgya rtsa brgyad dang*/ e myag ya rngub mug shag ka dun ag+na ye dgra bgegs che ge mo dz+wa la raṃ/ zhes dgang blugs brgya rtsa brgyad 'bul/ de nas mchod pa ni/ hūm̐ */ ya ma rā dza me yi lha// yab yum sras dang sprul par bcas// 'khor tshogs dregs pa'i dmag dpung la// dgra bgegs bsgral phyir mchod pa ni// rak+ta dmar gyi ar+ghaṃ dang*// ru dhī ra yi zhabs bsil dang*// dbang po rnam lnga'i me tog dang*// sha chen spos kyi dud pa dang*// tshil chen zhun gyi mar me dang*// mkhris chen su ra'i dri chab dang*| |sha chen rus pa'i zhal zas dang*// rkang gling gdug pa'i rol mor bcas// dgra bgegs bsgral phyir 'bul lags na// bzhes la drag po'i phrin las mdzod// oṃ ya ma rā dza ag+na ye ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā/ nas/ shapada'i bar gyis mchod nas/ slar yang*/ hūm̐ */ rtsa brgyad stong sbyar sman gyi mchog /rgyu rkyen sbyar ba'i rak+ta dang*// ba ling sha khrag bcas pa 'di// 'bul gyi bzhes la dgra bgegs bsgrol// oṃ ya ma rā dza ag+na ye sarba pañca a mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ zhes sman dang*/ de bzhin du/ ma hā rak+ta dang*/ ma hā ba ling+tas gtor ma dbul/ bstod ring gis bstod/ na mo bla ma la sogs zlog pa'i skabs ltar thal mo brdab/ 'dod don gsol zhing dmod bcol dang bcol dam drag tu bya/ slar yang rdzas lhag ma dang*/ til mar lhag ma rang rang gi sngags kyis bsreg /grangs bcad mi dgos/ de nas gong ltar mchod cing*/

gru gsum mthing nag mas bstod/ bdag gi tshe rabs sogs yig brgya dang bcas pas lhag chad bskang*/ lha yi lha mchog dang*/ bskal pa dpag tu med pa'i smon lam btab/ oṃ/ khyod kyis sogs dang*| badz+ra muḥ ye shes pa rnams rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rnams rang la thim par gyur/ ces gshegs su gsol/ bsngo ba smon lam dang shis brjod bya/ dug khrag gis me gzhil/ thal sol cha gcig rlung la bskur/ cha gcig mnan gtad gang rung bya/ gcig gtor mar rtsal nas zor du 'phang ngo*// zhes pa ni zla gsang dregs pa tshar gcod kyi rgyud kyi le'u nyer gnyis pa dang*/ sdig pa stobs chen gyi rgyud kyi le'u bcu drug pa dang*/ gshin rje dmar nag 'bar ba'i dme rgyud kyi le'u nga gcig pa rnams nas btus pa 'di ni chu bya zla ba bcu pa'i tshes bco brgyad la/ 'bri gung pa sngags 'chang chos kyi grags pas bye ri stag rtser zin bris bgyis pa yin no// yang zlog zla gsang gi bsnyen pa kha skong dang*/ phrin las bzhi'i ya gyal drag po'i skabs sogs las rab 'byams rnams la ni/ drag po'i sreg chog rgyud sde spyi 'gro ltar rdzas sna bcu gsum yod pa tshad ldan du bya dgos la// srung zlog bsad pa'i las mjug gi mtha' rgyas liṅga sreg pa dang glo bur du dgra bgegs kyi 'tshe ba la sreg las bsad pa kho na dmigs bsal du byed na 'di kho na zab par go bas de skad ces gdams so// //sarba maṅga laṃ//
